notes: Script paths are relative to Scripts/scenarios and may not escape it. Interpreters are fixed constants; no command strings from user input. Badges: SAFE, MODIFIES FILES, ADMIN, DESTRUCTIVE, LONG RUNNING.

scenarios.label: DDS to PNG
scenarios.description: Converts every .dds next to the chosen folder into .png via texconv. Writes new files alongside; originals untouched.

scenarios.label: DDS to TGA
scenarios.description: Converts every .dds next to the chosen folder into .tga via texconv. Writes new files alongside; originals untouched.

scenarios.label: PNG to DDS
scenarios.description: Converts .png files into .dds via texconv. Writes new files alongside; originals untouched.

scenarios.label: TGA to DDS
scenarios.description: Converts .tga files into .dds via texconv. Writes new files alongside; originals untouched.

scenarios.label: TGA to DDS (alt settings)
scenarios.description: Alternative texconv TGA-to-DDS profile. Writes new files alongside; originals untouched.

scenarios.label: PIC to TGA
scenarios.description: Decodes Battlezone .PIC images into .tga. Writes new files alongside; originals untouched.

scenarios.label: DDS to B&W
scenarios.description: Overwrites every .dds in the chosen folder in place with a pure black-and-white graded copy. No backup. Originals are lost.

scenarios.label: TGA to B&W
scenarios.description: Overwrites every .tga in the chosen folder in place with a grayscale graded copy. No backup. Originals are lost.

scenarios.label: Upscale TGA 2x
scenarios.description: Upscales .tga files 2x with sharpening. Writes suffixed copies; originals untouched.

scenarios.label: Upscale TGA 8x
scenarios.description: Upscales .tga files 8x. Writes suffixed copies; originals untouched.

scenarios.label: Compress images (lossless)
scenarios.description: DISABLED: losslessly shrinks .jpg/.png files with jpegoptim/oxipng; bundled binaries not shipped.
dependencies: blocked:jpegoptim.exe/oxipng.exe provenance unverified (T-166 manifest; hashes recorded, not copied)

scenarios.label: Replace DDS from PNG
scenarios.description: DISABLED: repacks .png back over .dds names; replace-in-place semantics not yet proven.

scenarios.label: Tag MP3 (batch)
scenarios.description: Batch-writes artist/title/album tags onto .mp3 files in the chosen folder.

scenarios.label: Album tool
scenarios.description: Interactive album artwork and album tags GUI for .mp3 files. The GUI has its own folder picker; no launcher folder is passed.

scenarios.label: MP3 win tool
scenarios.description: Interactive MP3 tag/album helper operating on the chosen folder.

scenarios.label: Rename MP3 from tags
scenarios.description: Renames .mp3 files in the chosen folder from their embedded tags.

scenarios.label: Tag from filenames (TagLib)
scenarios.description: DISABLED: writes tags from filenames via TagLibSharp; bundled DLL provenance unverified.
dependencies: blocked:TagLibSharp.dll provenance unverified (T-166 manifest; hash recorded, not copied)

scenarios.label: Tag from list (ffmpeg)
scenarios.description: DISABLED: ffmpeg-based retag via re-encode; enabled only after output verification.
scenarios.blocked_reason: re-encode output not yet verified against source quality

scenarios.label: Mute WAV intro
scenarios.description: Mutes the first seconds of .wav files; keeps a .wav.bak copy of each original next to it.

scenarios.label: M3U to FFmpeg List
scenarios.description: Reads the first .m3u in the selected folder and writes list.txt (ffmpeg concat input). Does not create an .m3u playlist.

scenarios.label: Video compressor
scenarios.description: DISABLED (T-167 decision): batch AV1 compressor (Git Bash) is a legacy bulk tool whose source directories are fixed personal library paths; kept in the tree for reference, deliberately not a supported SAITULS action. Explorer menu 'Сжать в AV1' (FFMPEG_MENU/MKV_FIX) is the supported per-file replacement.
scenarios.blocked_reason: T-167: hardcoded personal source dirs + Git Bash dependency + destructive original-deletion loop do not fit the SAITULS per-file action contract; supported surface = Explorer 'Сжать в AV1' verb instead

scenarios.label: Strip media metadata
scenarios.description: Removes EXIF/ID3 metadata from media files in the chosen folder, rewriting them in place. The stripped data is not recoverable.

scenarios.label: Office Scrubber
scenarios.description: DISABLED: Microsoft OffScrub bundle removes Office installations (admin, product uninstall). Launch contract merge pending.
scenarios.blocked_reason: launch-contract merge pending: admin + uninstall semantics of bundled OffScrub scripts not yet individually reviewed

scenarios.label: Backup monitor
scenarios.description: DISABLED: Battlezone backup monitor. Paths must move to user config before enable.
scenarios.blocked_reason: hardcoded paths must become configurable before enable (T-166 §U)
